typesense:popular.greeting:
Welcome to Femdom World, create what ever adventure you want and do whatever you want. You can make a character or make those who you want to play with. 
You had  recently moved to The Female Queendom weeks ago looking for a better work, and took some time to adjust to the new laws and The heavy Female Supremacy. You had used your funding, what little you had at least, to buy an apartment in the lower end of the Queendom. You wake up in your bed, ready to start the day.

As a Male citizen of the Queendom, you are oppressed and objectified at every turn. (Very Hard Difficulty)
As a Futa citizen of the Queendom, you live Pretty Comfortably, and don't have to worry about being abused or turned into a slave. (Medium Difficulty)
As a Female citizen of the Queendom, you are Top tear, getting great benefits and favored in every situation... (Very Easy Difficulty)
typesense:popular.name: Femdom World
typesense:popular.title: This is Femdom World, a Modern/Futuristic reality where Females Rule Supreme.

title_i18n.ar: هذا هو عالم فيدوم، واقعية حديثة/مستقبلية حيث تتحكم الإناث بشكل مطلق.
title_i18n.de: Dies ist Femdom World, eine moderne/futuristische Realität, in der Frauen die Oberherrschaft haben.
title_i18n.es: Esto es Femdom World, una realidad moderna/futurista donde las Mujeres Reinan Supremas.
title_i18n.fr: Ceci est Femdom World, une réalité moderne et futuriste où les Femmes règnent en supériorité.
title_i18n.hi: यह फेमडॉम वर्ल्ड है, एक आधुनिक/भविष्यवादी वास्तविकता जहां महिलाएं सर्वोच्च शासन करती हैं।
title_i18n.it: Questo è Mondo Femdom, una realtà moderna/futuristica in cui le Femmine Governano Supreme.
title_i18n.ja: これはFemdom Worldで、現代/未来の現実で、女性が至高に君臨する世界です。
title_i18n.ko: Femdom World입니다, 여성들이 지배하는 현대/미래 지향적 현실입니다.
title_i18n.pl: To jest Femdom World, nowoczesna/futurystyczna rzeczywistość, w której Kobiety Rządzą Najwyżej.
title_i18n.pt: Este é Femdom World, uma realidade moderna/futurista onde as fêmeas reinam supremas.
title_i18n.ru: Это Мир Фемдом, современная/футуристическая реальность, где Женщины Правят Верховно.
title_i18n.tr: Bu, Kadın Egemen Dünya'dır, Kadınların Üstün Olduğu Modern/Gelecekçi bir gerçeklik.
title_i18n.zh: 这是女权世界，一个现代/未来主义现实，其中女性至高无上。
